manifest_row.title: Origins Of The Republican Party's Implosion (Or Explosion)

screening.main_topic: The origins of the Republican Party's political direction and its response to Donald Trump, including implications for cleantech and climate policy.
screening.climate_relevance: A dedicated section links Republican opposition to climate action and cleantech to fossil-fuel industry contributions, attitudes toward social change, and the perceived effects of climate change on vulnerable groups. Reader comments also discuss climate denial and the politics of renewable energy.
screening.reason: The article is mainly an analysis of Republican Party politics, not climate coverage. However, climate change and clean energy receive meaningful, sustained discussion as an important application of the article's argument, so the text is relevant to broader climate discourse.
